answer_1.quote: Keyphrase generation (KPG) is the task of automatically predicting such keyphrases given the source text.
models: RNN (GRU-based Seq2Seq with copy and coverage)
answer_1.outputs: A set of keyphrases (multi-word phrases) generated for each source text.

answer_2.quote: We use F1@5, F1@10, F1@O and F1@M to evaluate a model's performance. Additionally, we provide an average score for each of the 4 metrics over all datasets... For absent keyphrase generation tasks we use R@10 and R@50.
